Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.Why Join Us Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.IMPORTANT Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.Compensation:$40-60/hour depending on experience

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.ResponsibilitiesActive Sourcing Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs. Candidate Outreach Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow Pipeline Management Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting What Success Looks Like Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over timeRequirements Must Have 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously Strong Plus Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads) Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)Who This Role Is For (& Not For) This Role Is For You If: You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time This Role Is NOT For You If: You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination onlyCompensation & Benefits Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company's growth and direction Fully remote: work from anywhere PTO: 2 Weeks Flex Day: An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness. Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet. Coaching credits:$1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional developmentReady to Apply? If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status. Responsibilities Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js Develop and implement highly responsive UI components Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications Monitor and improve end-to-end performance Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems  Required Experience Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software A focus on customer value delivery Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake  Desired Experience University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field  Additional Information Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays Start: ASAP  Core Client Values The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture. Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.  About Velozient We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Garantir o setup completo de cada unidade (ativação em até 30 dias).  Assegurar que cada novo ponto entregue entre 20 a 40 novas adesões logo no primeiro mês de operação.      2. Gestão de Pessoas e Liderança   Recrutar, treinar e manter ativos de 10 a 15 consultores externos (ou representantes) por regional.  Realizar a gestão direta de líderes de equipe, cobrando metas e desenvolvendo talentos.  Garantir o volume mínimo de 100 a 150 novas adesões por regional mês a mês.      3. Gestão de Performance (Rampa de Evolução)  Monitorar e acelerar o desempenho de cada escritório aberto seguindo o cronograma:   Mês 1 (Setup): Foco em recrutamento e 20-40 adesões.  Mês 2 (Ativação): Foco em volume de 80-120 adesões.  Mês 3 (Escala): Estabilização em 150+ adesões por regional.      4. Operacional e Marketing   Gerir a logística e distribuição do kit promocional (Lixo car, panfletos, cheirinhos, banners, tendas e balões).  Zelar pelo veículo plotado e ferramentas corporativas (notebook/celular).  Reportar resultados semanais de produção e adimplência à diretoria.      Perfil Desejado (Requisitos)   Experiência: Sólida vivência em gestão comercial externa, preferencialmente nos setores de proteção veicular, consórcios, seguros ou rastreamento.  Habilidades: Perfil  Hunter  (caçador de negócios), alta capacidade de negociação B2B (parcerias com postos) e liderança de equipes remotas.  Disponibilidade: Total para viagens e atuação em campo.  Diferencial: Possuir rede de contatos de consultores de vendas na região de atuação.    Principais Responsabilidades  Liderar a expansão comercial em novas regiões e mercados  Recrutar, treinar e acompanhar equipes comerciais externas  Estruturar e desenvolver novos pontos de atuação e parcerias  Definir metas e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da equipe  Garantir o crescimento sustentável da base de clientes  Realizar visitas externas e acompanhamento de campo  Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novos canais de vendas  Reportar resultados e estratégias à diretoria

This professional actively supports the industrialization cycle  from first RD prototypes through NPI delivery to mass production  executing BOM control, product cost modeling, and equipment management for NPI, helping our customers  products achieve world-class manufacturing quality, competitive costs, and scalable production. title: Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

JOB MISSION   HwIT is seeking a Packaging  Product Development Engineer focused on optical commutations products. You will be a key technical contributor supporting the hardware lifecycle of our photonic modules  from assisting in mechanical/thermal simulations and 3D CAD design to the execution, validation, and optimization of cleanroom packaging processes.  Your main focus will be a hands-on environment bridging RD design with manufacturing reality: supporting multiphysics simulations, detailing micro-assemblies, executing DOEs (Design of Experiments) for method validation, and technically investigating root causes to ensure structural integrity and maximize yield in global scale production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1. Product Development and Validation  ·       Mechanical  Optomechanical Design for Packaging: Develop 3D CAD models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for high-precision optoelectronic packages, test fixtures, and structural assemblies, applying GDT standards.  ·       Multiphysics  Thermal Simulation: Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to simulate thermal dissipation, mechanical stress, and structural integrity of photonic modules.  ·       Prototyping  Design Validation: Support the rapid prototyping phase and work closely with the Reliability testing team to validate simulation models against empirical data from testing (e.g., Telcordia GR-468, MIL-STD).  2. Process Development and Validation  ·       Critical Parameter Optimization: Assist in defining and optimizing critical process parameters such as die attach (e.g., conductive epoxies, eutectic soldering), wire bonding, and optical alignment.  ·       Encapsulation Techniques: Develop hermetic and semi-hermetic encapsulation techniques for photonic modules.  ·       Material Qualification: Validate new materials, adhesives, and sealing processes according to high-reliability standards.  3. Yield Optimization and Troubleshooting  ·       Root Cause Investigation: Run investigative activities in cleanroom processes to detect the root cause of issues affecting the yield and assembly times of photonic components.  ·       Design of Experiments (DOE): Run DOEs to characterize processes, define critical variables, and find the best assembly recipes.  ·       SPC Alignment: Validate and approve operational methods and process parameters consistent with the Statistical Process Control (SPC) required by Product Engineering.            4. NPI Integration and Manufacturability  ·       Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Execute DFM and development activities in packaging components under senior guidance, promoting technical alignment between suppliers and developers, and evaluating the technical feasibility of new components.  ·       Team Training: Documentation and training the operational team in the meticulous execution of complex encapsulation recipes and methodologies;  ·       Process Transference: Collaborate side-by-side with Product Engineers and Senior Packaging Engineers to validate assemblies and transfer packaging assembly processes to high-volume manufacturing sites.   CANDIDATE PROFILE   Education  Background  Essential:  ·       Bachelor s Degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or related fields.  ·       Minimum of 25 years of solid experience in microelectronic or optoelectronic packaging processes.  ·       Knowledge of structural adhesives, precision soldering, and interconnect metallurgy.  ·       Familiarity with failure analysis methodologies (SEM, EDS, X-Ray, Cross-section).  ·       Experience in optomechanical design, precision mechanics, or electronic hardware packaging.  ·       Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor) and understanding of GDT.  ·       Track record participating in thermal and structural simulations using tools like ANSYS, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Simulation.  Desirable:  ·       Experience with PICs (Photonic Integrated Circuits) and fiber-to-chip interfaces.  ·       Knowledge of reliability standards (MIL-STD-883, Telcordia GR-468, or NASA EEE-INST-002).  ·       Experience with continuous improvement tools (Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing).  ·       Knowledge of automation programming in Python, C#, or LabVIEW.  ·       Experience designing complex hermetic packages (e.g., Butterfly, TO-can) and managing micro-assembly tolerances.  ·       Background in designing customized mechanical fixtures for High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) and environmental testing.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native;   ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level) for day-to-day communication with international partners.  ·       Spanish: Desirable.

Trabalhar de acordo com regulamentos ambientais e normas para manuseio de gases refrigerantes.  Garantir o correto uso de EPIs e a organização dos materiais e ferramentas.  Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:  Atuar no treinamento e orientação de técnicos juniores e auxiliares.  Buscar aprimoramento contínuo por meio de treinamentos técnicos e certificações.    Necessario disponibilidade para viagens curtas.

Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)   Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna.   Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.  2. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente.   Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico.  3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)   Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento.   Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais.   Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia.    Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)   Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres).   Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável.   Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias.   Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. title: Coordenador(a) de Controladoria
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Controladoria em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

QUEM SOMOS   Nascemos fruto da união de propósitos entre a Bunge e UPL, uma joint venture de proposta inovadora e exclusiva: levar a solução completa ao produtor.   Somos a ORÍGEO e viemos construir uma relação próxima que simplifique o dia a dia da lavoura, lado a lado do produtor sendo seu parceiro da semente à comercialização, visando uma agricultura produtiva, sustentável e em constante evolução.    PROPÓSITO DO CARGO    Estamos em busca de um(a) coordenador(a) para atuar de forma estratégica na área contábil, com responsabilidade sobre a supervisão dos fechamentos mensais e anuais, controle de ativos fixos e integrações sistêmicas no SAP, garantindo aderência às normas contábeis, fiscais e regulatórias. A posição inclui a elaboração e análise de relatórios societários conforme IFRS e CPCs, suporte técnico a stakeholders, condução de auditorias internas e externas, análise crítica do balanço patrimonial e liderança do time de analistas. O(a) profissional também será peça-chave na jornada de melhoria contínua, avaliando requisitos legais, controles internos e regras do sistema ERP.    RESPONSABILIDADES    Orientar, supervisionar e/ou realizar diariamente o controle da contabilidade da empresa, ativos fixos e rotinas de relatórios, incluindo monitoramento dos lançamentos manuais, integração entre os módulos SAP para garantir o cumprimento de todos os padrões contábeis relevantes;   Orientar, supervisionar e/ou executar o controle do cronograma de fechamento da empresa, a fim de garantir que a alocação de custos de final de mês e de final de ano seja executada de maneira precisa e tempestiva;   Orientar e auxiliar os stakeholders internos e externos nos assuntos técnicos de contabilidade;   Auxiliar e conduzir as rotinas periódicas de auditoria externa e interna;   Desenvolver processos eficientes para a elaboração de relatórios societários em conformidade com os princípios contábeis (IFRS) e legislação aplicável (CPC´s);   Supervisionar e apoiar o trabalho dos analistas;   Responder a consultas de colaboradores e clientes internos, solicitações urgentes com precisão e precisão;   Apoiar a jornada de melhoria contínua, avaliando requisitos legais, controles internos e regras do sistema ERP;   Garantir a conformidade com as normas fiscais e tributárias, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações legais;   Realizar análises detalhadas do balanço patrimonial, identificando tendências, variações e pontos de atenção.     QUALIFICAÇÕES    Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis (CRC Ativo);   Experiência com gestão de pessoas;   Inglês nível intermediário (escrita e leitura);   Sólida experiência na área contábil/controladoria;   Experiência comprovada no atendimento à auditoria (Big Four);   Conhecimento avançado em normas contábeis (CPC, IFRS, USGAAP);   Domínio de Excel e sistemas ERP (SAP);   Disponibilidade para viagens.     Desejável:    Conhecimento no Agronegócio;   Pós-graduação ou MBA.     Modalidade de Trabalho: 4X1 (segunda à quinta-feira presencial / home office às sextas-feiras)   Nós, da ORÍGEO, acreditamos que um time com diversidade constrói grandes histórias. Por isso, se você é uma Pessoa com Deficiência e se identificou com essa vaga, participe do nosso processo seletivo!

title: SDR
description:
Nova vaga disponível para SDR em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

SDR (Inbound & Outbound)   Mobiis   Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil    Sobre a Mobiis     A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala.    Resumo da função     O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível.    Principais responsabilidades     Atuar tanto em  outbound   (ligações ativas, cadências e prospecção) quanto em  inbound   (leads vindos de marketing, eventos, formulários e outros canais).   Qualificar leads e prospects, entendendo necessidades, desafios, orçamento, perfil decisor e timing.   Realizar abordagens consultivas, apresentando de forma objetiva as soluções da Mobiis.   Agendar reuniões e demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers / executivos de conta).   Realizar follow-ups estratégicos ao longo do ciclo inicial de pré-vendas.   Registrar e atualizar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade.   Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas para melhoria contínua de scripts, discursos e campanhas.   Atingir metas mensais de leads qualificados e reuniões agendadas.     Requisitos obrigatórios     Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales ou funções similares, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.   Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e resiliência a objeções.   Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a processos e metas.   Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e rotina de pré-vendas.   Interesse e facilidade para aprender sobre soluções tecnológicas.     Requisitos desejáveis     Experiência com modelos de vendas inbound e outbound.   Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou logística.   Conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.   Inglês intermediário.   Capacidade de adaptação a metas desafiadoras e ambientes de rápido crescimento.

Auxílio Combustível: apoio para facilitar o deslocamento para as ações externas, contribuindo com os custos de combustível. Para fortalecer a nossa diversidade, queremos expandir a pluralidade da nossa gente, buscando equidade e valorizando diferentes perspectivas, pautadas nos pilares de Gênero, LGBTI+, Raça, Pessoas com Deficiência e 50+ tornando o nosso ambiente mais diverso e representativo. A sua função é garantir que as políticas comerciais da franqueadora se concretizem, sempre ajudando os vendedores a desempenharem sua função da melhor forma possível.   Deve estar continuamente disponível para esclarecer dúvidas, dar informações e ajudar nos vários processos que envolvem a venda, junto ao time de vendas e clientes.   Trabalhar o desenvolvimento dos vendedores no cumprimento dos desafios da meta mensal da loja, indicando boas práticas de melhoria constante, com habilidade relacional para mobilizar a força de vendas na direção do aprendizado, na melhoria pessoal e no aumento do rendimento. title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM  Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location   : Campinas, Brazil    Role Overview     We are expanding our  Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation   and are looking for a  SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our  platform and connectivity environments   .   This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on  platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability   . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.    Key Responsibilities     Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including  APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior   .   Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents.   Classify incidents by domain:  platform, connectivity, or device-related   .   Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues.   Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration.   Create, update, and manage incident tickets in  Fresh service or similar tools   .   Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates.   Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information.   Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams.   Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in  Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology   , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.  1–3 years of experience   in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations.   Foundational understanding of  mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts   .   Basic knowledge of  APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis   .   Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred   .   Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior.   Comfortable working  rotational shifts and on-call rotations   .   Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required   .   Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers.   Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience.   Experience with ticketing tools such as  Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management   .   Certifications such as  CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900  , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.     Soft Skills     Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable.   Calm under pressure.   Strong ownership and accountability.   Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability.   Global mindset and collaborative approach.   Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.     About Acceleronix     Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the  Quectel  ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.   With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.    Life at Acceleronix LATAM     At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem   Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas   Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams   A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development     Industries & Applications     Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions   Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility   Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking   Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring   Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring   Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility   Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security     Why Acceleronix LATAM?    Global Impact, Regional Focus —   Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.   Career Growth & Development —   Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.   Cutting-Edge Technology —   Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications.   Diversity & Inclusion —   Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.   Global Team & Collaboration —   Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.     Compensation & Benefits     Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks   Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent)  Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance)  Health insurance with no co-pay   Life insurance   Paid time off   International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)    Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources     We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.
